categories.label: Story Missions
categories.intro: All 69 story missions, in order. Gold medal every mission for the platinum-level challenge, or just play through for the 100% stat. ★ marks missions on the easy path to your 70 Gold Medals for [Solid Gold, Baby!](poi:achievement-solid-gold-baby) - the rest are still doable, just tougher, so skip them if you've already got your 70.

categories.label: Strangers & Freaks
categories.intro: 63 side missions across every character, including Trevor's 5 Rampages. Only 20 (Franklin's) count toward the game's own 100% stat, but the full set is tracked here. ★ marks the easiest Gold Medals toward [Solid Gold, Baby!](poi:achievement-solid-gold-baby) (any 70 of 115 total, across both this list and Story Missions).

categories.label: Spaceship Parts
categories.intro: 50 glowing parts scattered across San Andreas. All 50 are required for 100%.

categories.label: Letter Scraps
categories.intro: 50 scraps of Beverly's stalker letters. All 50 are required for 100%.

categories.label: Stunt Jumps
categories.intro: 50 vehicle stunt jumps. Only 25 are required for the game's 100% stat.

categories.label: Knife Flights
categories.intro: 15 tight aircraft gaps to fly through. Only 8 are required for 100%.

categories.label: Under the Bridge
categories.intro: 50 bridges to fly under. Only 25 are required for 100%.

categories.label: Nuclear Waste
categories.intro: 30 underwater barrels, retrievable by submarine from the Sonar Collections Dock. Bonus content - not required for 100%.

categories.label: Monkey Mosaics
categories.intro: 50 street-art mosaics tagged across Los Santos by a mysterious artist. Enhanced Edition exclusive - bonus content, not required for 100%.

categories.label: Submarine Pieces
categories.intro: 30 wreckage pieces scattered across the seabed, assembled for Abigail Mathers' Strangers & Freaks strand. Bonus content - not required for 100%.

categories.label: Epsilon Tracts
categories.intro: 10 tracts hidden across San Andreas, unlocked one at a time after finishing the Epsilon Program missions. Bonus content - not required for 100%.

categories.label: Hidden Packages
categories.intro: 15 cash-filled briefcases - 11 sunk in the ocean, 4 waiting at the Altruist Camp after the cult shootout. Bonus content - not required for 100%.

categories.label: Realty Signs
categories.intro: 15 Lenny Avery 'For Sale' signs to destroy for Josh Bernstein's Strangers & Freaks strand. Missable - bonus content, not required for 100%.

categories.label: Peyote Plants
categories.intro: 27 peyote cacti scattered across San Andreas - eat one to transform into an animal for a while. Bonus content - not required for 100%.

categories.label: Hobbies & Pastimes
categories.intro: Shooting range, races, golf, tennis, darts, flight school, parachuting and more. 42 of the full set count toward 100%.

categories.label: Random Events
categories.intro: Events that trigger while traversing the map. Only 14 of 57 are required for 100%.

categories.label: Properties
categories.intro: Income-generating businesses and vehicle storage. 5 income-generating properties are required for 100%.

categories.label: Playing Cards
categories.intro: GTA Online: 54 scattered playing cards, one for every card in a standard deck - collecting them all pays out escalating Casino Chips (66,650 total) plus the High Roller outfit and other Diamond Casino & Resort rewards. Added with the Diamond Casino & Resort update.

categories.label: Signal Jammers
categories.intro: GTA Online: 50 signal jammers hidden on rooftops and landmarks across San Andreas - destroy each for $2,000 + 1,000 RP. Clearing all 50 pays a $50,000 bonus and unlocks Avi Schwartzman as a hacker option for the Diamond Casino Heist. Added with the Diamond Casino Heist update.

categories.label: Action Figures
categories.intro: GTA Online: 100 movie-tie-in action figures hidden around Los Santos, mostly inside businesses and interiors. Added with the Los Santos Tuners update. Collecting all 100 pays escalating GTA$ (242,750 total) plus the Toy Soldier outfit.

categories.label: Movie Props
categories.intro: GTA Online: 10 movie props hidden across Los Santos and Blaine County for Solomon Richards, added with the Los Santos Summer Special. Collecting all 10 unlocks the Space Interloper Outfit.

categories.label: LD Organics Product
categories.intro: GTA Online: 100 LD Organics Product stashes scattered across the map, added with Los Santos Drug Wars. Finding them all unlocks clothing and a vehicle livery.

categories.label: Peyote Plants (Online)
categories.intro: GTA Online: 76 peyote plants across San Andreas - eat one to roam as an animal for a while. A separate set from the single-player peyote plants. A golden peyote near Mount Chiliad, available once the other 76 are done, turns you into the Sasquatch.

categories.label: Bunker Research
categories.intro: GTA Online: all 51 Disruption Logistics research projects, unlocked one at a time from the Gunrunning bunker. Each one adds a weapon attachment, ammo type, livery, or weaponized-vehicle upgrade. Projects arrive in a random order in-game; the numbering here is just the wiki's list order.

categories.label: Treasure Hunts
categories.intro: GTA Online one-time treasure hunts, each a short clue chain ending in a unique weapon, plus a bonus unlock for that weapon in Red Dead Redemption 2.

categories.label: Snowmen
categories.intro: GTA Online: 25 snowmen to smash, available only during the festive season (roughly mid-December to early January) and back every year. Not required for anything - purely seasonal.

categories.label: Store Robberies
categories.intro: GTA Online, Free Mode only: 20 robbable convenience and liquor stores scattered across Los Santos and Blaine County - needed for the "Stick Up Kid" trophy. Named locations and map placement aren't catalogued yet, so these are tracked as a plain numbered tally for now.

categories.label: GTA Online Awards
categories.intro: GTA Online career Awards from Pause Menu > Stats > Awards. Rockstar rates most Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum on repeated performance; the "one-time Platinum" ones jump straight to Platinum the first time you clear them and are starred here. Earning 30 Platinum Awards unlocks the [Decorated](poi:achievement-decorated) trophy.

pois.title: Los Santos Legend
pois.note: Awarded once every other trophy on this list has been collected.

pois.title: To Live or Die in Los Santos
pois.note: Finish the last main story mission - it doesn't matter which of the three endings you pick.

pois.title: San Andreas Sightseer
pois.note: Uncover the entire map - both Los Santos and Blaine County - along with most of the surrounding sea.

pois.note: Missable - wrap it up before the finale. See Michael's full Epsilon Program storyline through to the end.

pois.title: A Friendship Resurrected

pois.title: A Fair Day's Pay
pois.note: Unlocks automatically once you've finished the "Caida Libre" mission.

pois.title: The Moment of Truth
pois.note: Pops on its own when you complete "Bury the Hatchet."

pois.title: Diamond Hard
pois.note: Unlocks automatically once "The Jewel Store Job" is finished.

pois.title: Subversive

pois.title: Blitzed

pois.title: Small Town, Big Job
pois.note: Triggers automatically once "The Paleto Score" is completed.

pois.title: The Government Gimps
pois.note: Story-linked; pops automatically after finishing "The Bureau Raid."

pois.title: The Big One!
pois.note: Unlocks on its own when "The Big Score" is finished.

pois.title: All's Fare in Love and War
pois.note: Playing as Franklin, purchase the Downtown Cab Co. business and then finish one private fare.

pois.title: TP Industries Arms Race
pois.note: Trevor only, so it is lost if you end the story with [Something Sensible](poi:mission-069-something-sensible). Pick either other ending and Trevor lives, so you can finish it any time afterward. Have Trevor buy the McKenzie Field Hangar and clear all 10 gun-running missions.

pois.title: Multi-Disciplined
pois.note: Attain a gold medal in all applicable hobbies and pastimes.
pois.guide: Just one Gold per hobby type, not every individual challenge: Shooting Range, Flight School, Off-Road Race, Sea Race, Street Race, and Triathlon - 6 total. Street Races unlock through, and are satisfied by, Hao's Strangers & Freaks mission "Shift Work."

pois.title: From Beyond the Stars
pois.note: Locate all 50 spaceship parts, then play the resulting mission, "The Final Frontier," as Franklin to hand them over to Omega.

pois.title: A Mystery, Solved
pois.note: Track down all 50 of Leonora Johnson's letter scraps, then play the resulting mission as Franklin to find out who killed her.

pois.title: Waste Management
pois.note: Buy the abandoned dock and gather up every barrel of nuclear waste.

pois.title: Red Mist
pois.note: Trevor only, so it is lost if you end the story with [Something Sensible](poi:mission-069-something-sensible). With either other ending Trevor lives and you can finish this whenever. Clear all 5 of Trevor's Rampage challenges.

pois.title: Show Off
pois.note: Clear every Stunt Jump scattered around the map.

pois.title: Three Man Army
pois.note: Needs all three protagonists alive and switchable, so it is off the table after [Something Sensible](poi:mission-069-something-sensible) or [The Time's Come](poi:mission-069b-the-times-come). Keep everyone with [The Third Way](poi:mission-069c-the-third-way) and you can do it any time after the story. Gather Michael, Franklin, and Trevor together off-mission and hold a 3-star wanted level for 3 minutes.

pois.title: Out of Your Depth
pois.note: Let a shark take you down while you're out in open water.

pois.title: Altruist Acolyte
pois.note: Trevor only, so ending the story with [Something Sensible](poi:mission-069-something-sensible) closes it off; either other ending keeps him. Playing as Trevor, pick up a hitchhiker from a random encounter and drop them at the Altruist Cult instead of their real destination.

pois.title: A Lot of Cheddar
pois.note: Between Michael, Franklin, and Trevor, spend $200 million total.
pois.guide: The fastest legitimate route to $200 million is Lester's five assassination contracts - each one has a stock play attached (something to buy beforehand, something to sell into afterward, sometimes a second follow-up trade). Best tackled after the main story's done, once all three characters have full bankrolls to invest. Each mission below has its own specific stock and timing.

pois.title: Trading Pure Alpha
pois.note: Make a profitable trade on the in-game stock market.

pois.title: Pimp My Sidearm
pois.note: Max out every mod slot on a single weapon at Ammu-Nation.

pois.title: Wanted: Alive or Alive
pois.note: Trevor only, so [Something Sensible](poi:mission-069-something-sensible) rules it out. Maude also hands out only a limited run of bail-bond targets, so don't leave every one until last. Playing as Trevor, bring a target in alive and hand them to Maude.

pois.note: Fully customize a vehicle at any Los Santos Customs shop.

pois.title: Close Shave
pois.note: Finish off every Under the Bridge marker and every Knife Flight challenge.

pois.title: A New Perspective
pois.note: Log 15 cumulative hours playing in first-person view. Exclusive to the PS4/current-gen re-release - not available on PS3/360.

pois.title: Knife Flight 1
pois.note: A billboard is strung between two towers here - keep a wingtip clear of it as you thread through.

pois.title: Knife Flight 2
pois.note: One of the fifteen narrow gaps between Downtown Los Santos skyscrapers - line up early, hold your plane level, and commit to a straight, controlled pass through the buildings at speed.

pois.title: Knife Flight 3
pois.note: This opens a three-part combo continuing into the next two gaps, all flown in a single pass. Approach from the east near the overpass and bank 90 degrees left as you slip between the IAA and FIB towers.

pois.title: Knife Flight 4
pois.note: The middle leg of that same combo. Keep the wings rolled left, ease past the Union Depository's left side while letting the nose sink a little, then level out with light right rudder to slide between the Corporate & Investment Banking tower and the Gruppe 6 building.

pois.title: Knife Flight 5
pois.note: The closing gap of the combo, immediately following the previous one. Hold the left roll and dip the nose slightly for this last pass, squeezing between the Tinkle building and the Arcadius Business Center.

pois.title: Knife Flight 6
pois.note: Flown together with the next gap in a single run - come in from the south and steer wide of the crane.

pois.title: Knife Flight 7
pois.note: Follows right on the heels of the previous gap in the same run; maintain your bank angle through both and they'll count one after the other.

pois.title: Knife Flight 8
pois.note: This one's a narrow squeeze - retracting your landing gear and staying near the top of the opening helps you clear the structure waiting on the other side.

pois.title: Knife Flight 9
pois.note: Another of the tight passages between Downtown's skyscrapers - approach with plenty of altitude to spare, then dive shallow and hold a steady, level line as you pass through.

pois.title: Knife Flight 10
pois.note: A snug gap that leaves little room to recover on the other side - if the flight counts but you crash moments later, don't worry, the credit still stands, so just pull out another plane.

pois.title: Knife Flight 11
pois.note: Opens a two-gap sequence with the following flight. Line up on the dark-colored building, roll onto your left wing, and cut between the first pair of towers.

pois.title: Knife Flight 12
pois.note: Second half of that pairing, coming straight after the first - keep the left roll going through the next two towers, then climb sharply to clear the final one.

pois.title: Knife Flight 13
pois.note: One more of Downtown's fifteen skyscraper gaps - pick a clean, level approach line and hold your heading steady all the way through the opening.

pois.title: Knife Flight 14
pois.note: Another narrow pass between two of the downtown towers - build enough speed beforehand that you can hold a straight, controlled line without stalling mid-flight.

pois.title: Knife Flight 15
pois.note: The last of the fifteen downtown gaps - treat it the same as the others: a level, steady approach through the buildings at a safe, controllable speed.

pois.title: Purchase a Vehicle Online
pois.note: Order any single vehicle through one of the in-game car websites, accessed via a phone or in-world computer.

pois.title: Walk Chop
pois.note: Head out with Chop, Franklin's dog, for a stroll through the neighborhood.

pois.title: Play Fetch with Chop
pois.note: Toss a ball around the yard with Chop and let him fetch it.

pois.title: Booty Call
pois.note: Distinct from just paying for a dance (that's the Hobbies & Pastimes requirement) - rack up repeat private dances from the same Vanilla Unicorn dancer until she's added as a phone contact, then call her and follow through on the Booty Call itself.

pois.title: Hire a Prostitute
pois.note: Pull over for a streetwalker and pay for her company.

pois.title: Rob a Store
pois.note: Point a gun at a clerk in any of the 19 robbable corner shops or liquor stores and empty the till.

pois.title: Watch a Movie
pois.note: Catch a showing at any of the movie theaters scattered around Vinewood.

pois.title: Friend Activity: Cinema
pois.note: Ring up a friend and catch a film together at the theater.

pois.title: Friend Activity: Darts
pois.note: Meet up with a friend for a round of darts.

pois.title: Friend Activity: Strip Club
pois.note: Take a friend along on a night out at the Vanilla Unicorn.

pois.title: Friend Activity: Bar
pois.note: Grab drinks with a friend at a local bar.

pois.title: Prologue
pois.note: Nine years before the main story, a bank robbery in the snowy town of Ludendorff falls apart while playing younger versions of Michael, Trevor, and partner Brad.
pois.guide: There's no Gold Medal target for this one - simply finishing the mission satisfies the Bronze tier.

pois.title: Franklin and Lamar
pois.note: In Franklin's opening mission, he and Lamar reclaim a customer's overdue vehicle on behalf of Simeon's used-car dealership.
objectives: Deliver the repo car with minimal damage (Not a Scratch)
Use Franklin's special ability for 7 seconds (Focused Driver)
Win the race against Lamar (Winner)
Avoid hitting any aliens in the movie studio (We Come in Peace)

pois.title: Repossession
pois.note: Simeon sends Franklin and Lamar to repossess an overdue motorcycle in Vespucci Beach, and the job turns into a shootout with Vagos gang members guarding it.
objectives: Complete within 6:30
Shoot the gasoline trail to ignite it
Get 6 headshot kills
Finish with at least 70% shooting accuracy

pois.title: Complications
pois.note: Sent to repossess Jimmy De Santa's car from the family home, Franklin discovers Michael hiding in the back seat and is held at gunpoint on the drive back to the dealership.
objectives: Complete within 5:00
Take no damage during the fight with Simeon
Knock out the gardener with a stealth takedown

pois.title: Chop
pois.note: Franklin and Lamar, aided by Lamar's dog Chop, track down and kidnap a Ballas gang member named D.
objectives: Complete with minimal damage to Lamar's van
Use Chop's dog-vision perspective for 10 seconds
Use Franklin's special ability for 7 seconds

pois.title: Father/Son
pois.note: When Jimmy calls in a panic that thieves are stealing Michael's yacht, Michael and Franklin chase down the trailer hauling it to rescue him.
objectives: Rescue Jimmy within 10 seconds
Deliver Amanda's car with no damage

pois.title: Marriage Counseling
pois.note: Suspecting Amanda is having an affair, Michael chases down her tennis coach and discovers the house they were hiding in belongs to dangerous cartel figure Martin Madrazo.
objectives: Complete with minimal damage to the Bison
Complete within 5:30
Get 3 kills via drive-by shooting

pois.title: Daddy's Little Girl
pois.note: Tipped off that Tracey is partying on a stranger's yacht, Michael races to pull her off the boat before things go further.
objectives: Reach top speed on the Seashark jet ski
Don't fall off the bicycle
Swim to the boat within 1:00

pois.title: Friend Request
pois.note: Needing cash to pay off Martin Madrazo, Michael turns to his old friend Lester Crest, who first has him plant a bomb in a prototype phone to kill Lifeinvader founder Jay Norris.
objectives: Complete within 8:30
Clear all the pop-up ads within 32 seconds

pois.title: The Long Stretch
pois.note: Franklin joins Lamar and his rival Stretch for what's billed as a drug deal, only for it to be revealed as payback against D, sparking a shootout.
objectives: Finish with at least 60% shooting accuracy
Get 10 headshot kills
Complete with minimal health/armor damage taken
Complete within 10:30

pois.title: Casing the Jewel Store
pois.note: Lester sends Michael to scope out the Vangelico jewelry store, photographing its security as groundwork for the crew's debut heist.
objectives: Complete within 8:00
Photograph all 3 security features in a single picture

pois.title: Bugstars Equipment
pois.note: First Smart-approach setup job for the jewelry heist - Michael steals a Bugstars work van to supply disguises. Skipped entirely on a Loud playthrough.
objectives: Steal the Bugstars van without being detected (Sneaky Pest)

pois.title: BZ Gas Grenades
pois.note: Second Smart-approach setup job - Michael intercepts a van carrying the gas grenades needed to subdue the jewelry store's staff. Skipped entirely on a Loud playthrough.
objectives: Shoot open the van's back doors to release the cargo (Loose Cargo)

pois.title: Carbine Rifles
pois.note: Loud-approach setup job - Michael hijacks an LSPD tactical truck loaded with carbine rifles and delivers it to Darnell Bros. Skipped entirely on a Smart playthrough.
objectives: Lose your wanted level within 2:00 (Swift Getaway)

pois.title: The Jewel Store Job
pois.note: The actual robbery of the Vangelico jewelry store plays out through whichever style, stealthy Smart or aggressive Loud, was picked beforehand.
objectives: Steal the jewelry within 50 seconds (Quick Grab) - applies to both Smart and Loud
Protect Franklin during the LS River chase (Protégé Protected) - applies to both Smart and Loud
Loot all 20 glass display cabinets (Clean Sweep) - applies to both Smart and Loud

Get 12 headshot kills
Complete within 12:00
Cause $5000 of damage to Ortega's trailer
Kill Terry and Clay during the chase

Complete with minimal health/armor damage taken
Destroy 6 vehicles
Complete within 4:30

pois.title: Nervous Ron

Complete within 12:30
Win the race against Ron
Fly under all 6 bridges along the flight path
Kill all the bikers while lying on the plane wing

Complete with minimal health/armor damage taken
Kill 2 enemies with a single shot
Finish with at least 80% shooting accuracy

Destroy all trailers simultaneously (Perfect Gift)

Knock out the event coordinator (No, I Can Park Here)
Don't unhook the trailer (All Hooked Up)

objectives: Complete within 05:00
Deliver the Trashmaster with no damage (Undented)
Reach top speed in the Trashmaster (In the Dust)

objectives: Complete within 03:00

Reach top speed in the Tow Truck (Truckin')

pois.title: Getaway Vehicle (Blitz Play Vehicle)
pois.note: The crew scouts out and marks a discreet, untraceable getaway car to use once the Blitz Play robbery is done.
pois.guide: No Gold Medal target applies to this mission - reaching the Bronze tier is all that's required.

pois.title: Hotel Assassination
pois.note: Lester sends Franklin to eliminate a mark at a hotel as part of his stock-market manipulation scheme.
objectives: Kill the target using a sniper rifle (Sniper Kill Bonus)
Time Taken is tracked but appears to auto-fulfill regardless of duration
Money Earned from the hit cannot fail as long as the mission is completed
pois.guide: Before you take this contract, sink every dollar across all three characters into Betta Pharmaceuticals on BAWSAQ. Once the target's down, keep sleeping/saving to track the price and cash out around an 80% gain, then roll the proceeds into Bilkington on LCN - give that one roughly a week to climb before selling again.

pois.title: Blitz Play
pois.note: In broad daylight in downtown Los Santos, the crew pulls off a heist against an armored transport truck.
objectives: Shoot down the helicopter as Trevor (Hawk Down)
Kill 12 enemies with a headshot
Finish with at least 60% shooting accuracy
Switch characters 10 times (Switcher)

pois.title: I Fought The Law…
pois.note: Devin Weston has Franklin lure two rich kids into a street race while Michael and Trevor, disguised as highway patrol, intercept and steal their cars.
objectives: Race between the two trucks (Tight Squeeze)
Race between two busses (Bus Passed)
Follow Trevor through the tunnel (Follow the Leader)
Complete within 12:00
Use Franklin's special ability during the race (Split Seconds)

pois.title: The Multi Target Assassination
pois.note: For another of Lester's market-rigging contracts, Franklin has to take down several targets in a single outing.
objectives: Kill all targets as quickly as possible (Speedy Killer Bonus)
Money Earned equals base reward ($5000) plus speed bonus
pois.guide: Load every character's cash into Debonaire on LCN before starting this one. It tends to peak around an 80% return after the mission - sell out completely, then put everything into Redwood on the same exchange. Redwood runs much hotter, often clearing 300% before it tops out, so it's worth the extra few in-game days to wait.

pois.title: The Vice Assassination
pois.note: Franklin kills an executive connected to a rival company as part of Lester's stock manipulation plot.
objectives: Earn the full $3,000 money bonus from the hit
pois.guide: Buy into Fruit on BAWSAQ ahead of this contract; it usually climbs about 50% once the job's done. Sell there and shift the proceeds into Facade, also on BAWSAQ, for a smaller but still worthwhile follow-up gain before it levels off.

pois.title: The Bus Assassination
pois.note: One of Lester's contracts has Franklin taking out a target while riding along on a moving city bus.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 1
pois.note: This one sits in open water off the Los Santos coastline, resting on the seabed where visibility drops fast the deeper you go. You'll need the submarine from the Sonar Collections Dock, a property that only unlocks once "The Merryweather Heist" is behind you and you've got $250,000 to spare. Watch your sonar ping as you close in - the barrel's corroded shell blends into the rocks around it.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 2
pois.note: Tucked into a trench south of Elysian Island, this barrel is easy to swim right past if you're not paying attention to the sonar readout. Grab the submarine from the Sonar Collections Dock (available after "The Merryweather Heist" for a quarter-million) and descend slowly - the current down there can push you off course.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 3
pois.note: Out along the Pacific Bluffs stretch of coast, the seafloor drops off sharply and this drum has settled into a crevice. The Sonar Collections Dock submarine is the only way down to it; the dock itself becomes purchasable for $250,000 once the Merryweather job wraps up.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 4
pois.note: Rusted through and leaking faint green light, this barrel rests in murkier water than most, closer to the Alamo Sea's edge. Bring the sub out from the Sonar Collections Dock and trust the sonar pulse more than your eyes once you're this deep.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 5
pois.note: This is one of the deeper drops off Chumash, well past where casual swimmers would ever go. The submarine you'll need lives at the Sonar Collections Dock, which only opens up for purchase after "The Merryweather Heist" concludes.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 6
pois.note: Sitting near a shipwreck south of Vespucci Beach, this drum is half-buried in silt, so the sonar ping is more reliable than a visual sweep. You'll need the Sonar Collections Dock's submarine, unlocked for $250,000 once the Merryweather storyline is done.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 7
pois.note: Found in the deep water off Del Perro, this barrel has been down there long enough to grow a thin coat of algae. Take the submarine from the Sonar Collections Dock - remember, that property doesn't open up until after "The Merryweather Heist."

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 8
pois.note: This drum rests near a rock formation along the northern coast, closer to Paleto Bay than most of the others in this set. Approach in the Sonar Collections Dock submarine and keep an eye on your depth gauge - the terrain shifts quickly out there.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 9
pois.note: Off the coast near Cape Catfish, this barrel sits in a wide, flat stretch of seabed that makes it easier to spot on sonar than most. Still requires the submarine from the Sonar Collections Dock, purchasable for $250,000 after the Merryweather job.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 10
pois.note: Buried partway in sand south of the Los Santos harbor, this one's radiation symbol is barely visible under the grime. Descend in the Sonar Collections Dock's sub and let the sonar do the work - visual searching alone will eat up your oxygen.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 11
pois.note: This drum sits in a deep channel that cuts along Route 68's coastal edge, far enough out that the water goes dark fast. The Sonar Collections Dock submarine, bought after "The Merryweather Heist" for $250,000, is the only practical way to reach it.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 12
pois.note: Resting near a cluster of underwater rocks off Puerto Del Sol, this barrel has clearly been down there since before the story even starts. Bring the sub from the Sonar Collections Dock and follow the ping rather than guessing at shapes in the dark.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 13
pois.note: This one's out past the Alamo Sea's deeper stretch, in water cold and still enough that the barrel looks almost untouched by current. You'll need the Sonar Collections Dock submarine to get down there safely.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 14
pois.note: Sitting in a debris field south of Elysian Island, this drum is surrounded by other sunken junk that can make sonar readings noisy. Patience pays off once you're in the Sonar Collections Dock's submarine and closing in slowly.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 15
pois.note: Found off the Pacific Bluffs, wedged between two boulders where the current has clearly been dragging silt over it for years. The submarine from the Sonar Collections Dock (unlocked post-Merryweather for $250,000) is essential here - the gap is too tight to swim into blind.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 16
pois.note: This barrel rests in a shallower pocket near Chumash compared to most of the others, but the visibility is still poor enough that sonar beats eyesight. Take the Sonar Collections Dock sub out and trust the ping.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 17
pois.note: Out near Vespucci, this drum has settled into a small underwater basin that's easy to miss without sonar guidance. The Sonar Collections Dock submarine becomes available once "The Merryweather Heist" is finished and you've got the $250,000 to spend.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 18
pois.note: This one sits in deep water off Del Perro, far enough from shore that the light barely reaches the seabed. Approach carefully in the Sonar Collections Dock's submarine, watching your gauge as the terrain slopes downward.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 19
pois.note: Resting near the base of a rocky outcrop along the northern shoreline toward Paleto Bay, this barrel's faint glow is the easiest way to spot it once you're close. Bring the Sonar Collections Dock sub to get there.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 20
pois.note: This drum has drifted into a narrow gully off Cape Catfish, tucked in tight enough that sonar pings bounce oddly nearby. The Sonar Collections Dock submarine, purchasable after the Merryweather job for $250,000, is worth the investment for runs like this one.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 21
pois.note: Half-covered in sand south of the Los Santos harbor entrance, this barrel is one of the trickier ones to line up visually. Let the sonar ping steer your final approach once you're in the Sonar Collections Dock's submarine.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 22
pois.note: This one sits deep along the Route 68 coastal shelf, in water dark enough that your headlights barely help. The Sonar Collections Dock submarine, unlocked after "The Merryweather Heist," is the only reasonable way down.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 23
pois.note: Found wedged against rocks off Puerto Del Sol, this drum has clearly taken some damage from the current over time. Descend slowly in the Sonar Collections Dock's sub and watch for the sonar spike as you near it.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 24
pois.note: This barrel rests in the deeper reaches of the Alamo Sea, far enough from the shoreline that it's easy to lose your bearings. The Sonar Collections Dock submarine ($250,000, available post-Merryweather) makes the trip manageable.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 25
pois.note: Sitting among scattered debris south of Elysian Island, this drum blends into the wreckage around it more than most. Sonar is your best friend here once you're piloting the Sonar Collections Dock's submarine.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 26
pois.note: This one sits off the Pacific Bluffs in a stretch of water that's deceptively calm on the surface but murky below. Bring the Sonar Collections Dock sub and lean on the ping rather than visual scanning.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 27
pois.note: Resting near a rock shelf off Chumash, this barrel's faint radioactive glow cuts through the gloom just enough to catch on sonar. The Sonar Collections Dock submarine is required, and that property only opens up after "The Merryweather Heist."

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 28
pois.note: This drum has settled into a quiet stretch of seabed off Vespucci, away from the traffic of the marina above. The Sonar Collections Dock's submarine, bought for $250,000 post-heist, gets you down there without much trouble.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 29
pois.note: Found in deep water off Del Perro, this barrel sits in a spot where the current shifts often, so don't be surprised if your approach angle needs adjusting mid-dive. The Sonar Collections Dock submarine is the tool for the job.

pois.title: Nuclear Waste 30
pois.note: The last of the set rests in a deep pocket toward Paleto Bay's coastal waters, far enough out that few players ever stumble onto it by accident. Wrapping up this set means one final trip in the Sonar Collections Dock's submarine, purchasable for $250,000 once "The Merryweather Heist" is done.

pois.title: LSPD Auto Impound
pois.note: Franklin runs this impound lot as a towing operation, earning $500 for every vehicle he brings in. Opens up once Tonya Wiggins' side jobs are finished.

pois.title: Downtown Cab Co.
pois.note: Franklin-owned taxi firm that pays out $2,000 weekly and lets its owner hail cabs anywhere for free.

pois.title: McKenzie Field Hangar
pois.note: Opens up a string of Trevor-only gun-running jobs, both by land and by air, each paying somewhere between $5,000 and $7,000.

pois.title: Sonar Collections Dock
pois.note: Base for diving up radioactive waste barrels scattered around the map; $23,000 lands per barrel recovered, with a $250,000 bonus for salvaging the full set of 11. Available once The Merryweather Heist wraps.

pois.title: Los Santos Customs
pois.note: Weekly earnings of $1,600 from this customs branch, and owning it lets Franklin modify his cars here without paying a dime.

pois.title: Doppler Cinema
pois.note: Michael's cinema investment, bringing in $132,200 every week.

pois.title: Ten Cent Theater
pois.note: A Michael-owned picture house that generates $264,000 in weekly revenue.

pois.title: Tivoli Cinema
pois.note: Another cinema on Michael's books, worth $142,300 per week.

pois.title: Los Santos Golf Club
pois.note: This golf course pays its owner $264,500 weekly and waives green fees entirely, letting them tee off in whatever outfit they're wearing.

pois.title: Car Scrapyard
pois.note: Crush cars here for $150 a pop, regardless of which protagonist owns the yard.

pois.title: Smoke on the Water
pois.note: Franklin's seafood restaurant, clearing $9,300 a week.

pois.title: Tequi-la-la
pois.note: Nightclub earning $16,500 weekly for whichever protagonist buys it; the purchase only opens up after finishing the Vinewood Souvenirs mission involving Willy.

pois.title: Pitchers
pois.note: This dive bar brings in $7,100 a week no matter which of the three owns it.

pois.title: The Hen House
pois.note: Modest corner store earning $920 weekly, purchasable by any of the three leads.

pois.title: Hookies
pois.note: Bar generating $4,700 a week, available for purchase by either Franklin or Michael.

pois.title: Vanilla Unicorn
pois.note: Strip club paying $5,000 weekly that also serves as one of Trevor's safehouses, with ownership unlocking complimentary private dances.

pois.title: Puerto Del Sol Marina
pois.note: A dock where any of the three protagonists can keep their boats.

pois.title: Vespucci Helipad
pois.note: Helipad for storing choppers, open to purchase by Franklin or Michael.

pois.title: Los Santos International Hangar
pois.region: Los Santos International Airport, Los Santos
pois.note: Hangar for parking planes that also grants runway access at LSIA; buyable by Franklin or Michael.

pois.title: Sandy Shores Airfield
pois.note: Trevor's airfield for stashing both planes and helicopters, handed over free of charge once Nervous Ron is completed.

pois.title: Grove Street Garage
pois.note: Franklin's garage holds up to four vehicles and comes with access to the Special Vehicles menu.

pois.title: Pillbox Hill Garage
pois.note: Four-car garage for Trevor that also unlocks the Special Vehicles menu.

pois.title: Vinewood Garage
pois.note: Michael's four-car garage, which likewise opens up the Special Vehicles menu.

pois.title: Abandoned Vehicles 1
pois.region: Smoke Tree Road, Grand Senora Desert
pois.note: Approach a parked Surfer van and a prankster ambushes you, stripping you to your underwear and dumping you on the railway tracks.

pois.title: Abandoned Vehicles 2
pois.note: A Journey van sitting by itself conceals two rednecks who attack if you get too close.

pois.title: Arrests 1
pois.note: Side with an officer chasing down a runaway suspect, or take out the officer and let the suspect go free.

pois.title: Arrests 2
pois.region: Senora Freeway, RON Alternates Wind Farm
pois.note: Assist a park ranger in bringing down an escaping criminal, or gun down the ranger and free the criminal.

pois.title: ATM Robberies
pois.note: Run down a mugger snatching cash from someone at an ATM, then pocket the money or hand it back. This one keeps recurring, though completing it a single time is all that counts.

pois.title: Bike Thief City 1
pois.note: Track down a bike thief and bring the bicycle back to owner Gray Nicholson, earning a stamina increase plus a stock market tip.

pois.title: Bike Thief City 2
pois.note: Catch a bicycle thief and hand the bike back to its owner for a boost to stamina.

pois.title: Border Patrols 1
pois.region: Mount Haan Road, Grand Senora Desert
pois.note: A gang of bikers jumps you, assuming you're an outsider - fight them off.

pois.title: Border Patrols 2
pois.note: Motorcycle-riding rednecks mistake you for an immigrant and attack - take them down.

pois.title: Border Patrols 3
pois.note: A pack of bikers ambushes you here too, wrongly pegging you as a foreigner - deal with them.

pois.title: Burial
pois.note: Stop two men in the middle of burying a woman alive, then get her somewhere safe.

pois.title: Bus Tour
pois.note: Hop aboard a sightseeing bus through Vinewood and stay on until the route wraps up.

pois.title: Car Theft 1
pois.note: Pursue a carjacker who's made off with a woman's pink Peyote, and either give it back or drive off with it.

pois.title: Car Theft 2
pois.region: Exceptionalists Way, Los Santos International Airport
pois.note: Chase a thief fleeing with a woman's Rocoto and choose to return the car or keep it for yourself.

pois.title: Chase Thieves City 1
pois.note: Take down Lost bikers mid-robbery at a store and decide whether to keep or return the cash.

pois.title: Chase Thieves City 2
pois.note: Gun down Lost members after they snatch someone's wallet, then choose to keep the money or give it back.

pois.title: Chase Thieves Country 1
pois.note: Stop a wallet theft by Lost bikers out here as well, then keep or hand back the money.

pois.title: Chase Thieves Country 2
pois.note: Take out Lost gang members robbing a pedestrian outside the Checkout! store, then decide the cash's fate.

pois.title: Crash Rescue
pois.note: Rush Taliana Martinez, the only one left alive after a heist went sideways, to safety before she bleeds out - saving her adds her to your crew roster.

pois.title: Construction Accident
pois.note: Operate a Dozer to shift pipes and free a worker trapped in a Utility Truck that's caught fire.

pois.title: Countryside Gang Fight
pois.note: Free a hostage being threatened by Lost bikers, then hold off a second group that rolls in on motorcycles. Only available as Michael or Franklin.

pois.title: Countryside Robbery
pois.note: Come across a firefight between police and robbers - grab the briefcases left behind or aid the robbers' getaway.

pois.title: Deal Gone Wrong
pois.note: A drug deal has ended in a shootout - take the briefcase from the dying gangsters, then defend it from a gang sent to get it back.

pois.title: Domestic
pois.note: Offer a ride to a man his wife just threw out, which unlocks Castro Lagano as a tough golf rival.

pois.title: Drug Shootout
pois.note: Clear out the gunmen defending a small farm and take the briefcase stashed in a nearby shed. Trevor-exclusive, and it only happens once.

pois.title: Drunk Drivers 1
pois.note: Chauffeur an intoxicated man safely to his home on Alta Place in Hawick.

pois.title: Drunk Drivers 2
pois.note: Get a tipsy couple back to their motel room in one piece.

pois.title: Escape Paparazzi
pois.note: Shake off a horde of paparazzi chasing celebrity Lacey Jonas and get her home safely.

pois.title: Gang Intimidation
pois.region: El Rancho Boulevard, El Burro Heights
pois.note: A woman pleads for help, but it's a setup - follow her in and take out the armed crooks waiting to jump you. Michael or Trevor only.

pois.title: Getaway Driver
pois.region: Strawberry Avenue and Forum Drive, Strawberry
pois.note: Patrick McReary and his partner need a getaway after robbing a drugstore - help them flee or gun them down instead.

pois.title: Hitch Lift 1
pois.note: Get a broken-down motorist where he's headed inside two game hours to receive a Tinkle stock tip.

pois.title: Hitch Lift 2
pois.note: Drop Ursula off at home to unlock her as a Booty Call contact. Only Franklin and Trevor can trigger this.

pois.title: Hitch Lift 3
pois.region: East Joshua Road, San Chianski Mountain Range
pois.note: Take a hitchhiker home, then fend off her jealous boyfriend when he shows up swinging.

pois.title: Hitch Lift 4
pois.note: Escort a bride who's fled the altar home, while her groom chases you down.

pois.title: Luring Girl Into Alley
pois.note: A girl asks for assistance and leads you into a trap - eliminate her and her partner.

pois.title: Mugging 1
pois.note: Run down a pickpocket who's grabbed a pedestrian's wallet, then either keep the money or give it back.

pois.title: Mugging 2
pois.note: Intervene in an alley attack, taking out the assailant before he kills the woman.

pois.title: Mugging 3
pois.note: Pursue a wallet thief and decide whether to return the stolen cash or keep it.

pois.title: Prisoner Lifts 1
pois.region: Grand Senora Desert, north of Bolingbroke Penitentiary
pois.note: Get a runaway prisoner clear of the police tailing him. Only playable as Michael or Franklin.

pois.title: Prisoner Lifts 2
pois.region: Grand Senora Desert, south of Bolingbroke Penitentiary
pois.note: A prisoner asks for a ride, then ambushes you and steals your car - fight back and take him down.

pois.title: Rogue Altruists
pois.region: Baytree Canyon Road, Grand Senora Desert
pois.note: Take down Altruist Cult members assaulting a girl, then bring her home safe. Michael or Franklin only.

pois.title: Shop Robberies 1
pois.note: Run down the robbers fleeing a Bob Mulet barbershop, then keep or return what they stole.

pois.title: Shop Robberies 2
pois.note: Chase a thief running from a SubUrban store robbery and choose to keep the cash or hand it back.

pois.title: Simeon Yetarian
pois.region: Adam's Apple Boulevard and Power Street, Strawberry
pois.note: Repel a group of enforcers Simeon Yetarian sends after you at the Premium Deluxe Motorsport lot. Michael or Franklin only.

pois.title: Snatched
pois.region: South Mo Milton Drive, Vinewood Hills
pois.note: Free a girl taken captive by Lost bikers and get her somewhere safe.

pois.title: Sport Bike Thief
pois.note: Run down someone making off with a sports bike, then return it to its owner or ride off with it yourself.

pois.title: Stag Do Running Man
pois.note: Untie a groom left bound to a post, then rush him to a bar and on to his wedding inside five game hours.

pois.title: Security Van 1

pois.title: Death At Sea

pois.title: Grass Roots - Michael
pois.note: After a random meeting, Michael agrees to run a marijuana-fueled errand for Barry, the perpetually stoned hippie.
objectives: Complete with minimal damage to health and armor
Kill 7 aliens within 10 seconds

pois.title: Grass Roots - Trevor
pois.note: Trevor takes on a similarly weed-addled favor for Barry.
objectives: Destroy 4 clown vans before they can spawn clowns
Kill 6 clowns while they are dancing

pois.title: Grass Roots - Franklin
pois.note: Franklin also gets roped into one of Barry's marijuana-induced errands.

pois.title: Grass Roots - The Pickup
pois.note: Following his earlier dealings with Barry, Franklin is tasked with collecting a batch of weed for him.
objectives: Complete within 2:45
Don't get a wanted level

pois.title: Grass Roots - The Drag
pois.note: As a way of returning the favor, Barry challenges Franklin to a long cross-country race.
objectives: Complete within 1:30
Keep the stash car hooked until delivery

pois.title: Grass Roots - The Smoke-In
pois.note: The Grass Roots storyline closes out with Franklin joining Barry for one last relaxed hangout.

pois.title: Paparazzo
pois.note: Franklin crosses paths with sketchy paparazzo Beverly Felton and helps capture his first paparazzi shot of a celebrity.
objectives: Have Beverly take out his rival on the first attempt
Help Beverly snap and inspect 3 photographs

pois.title: Paparazzo - The S** Tape
pois.note: Beverly enlists Franklin to help hunt down a celebrity's leaked intimate video.
objectives: Jump in the pool while following Beverly
Achieve full facial recognition during the chase

pois.title: Paparazzo - The Partnership
pois.note: A planned celebrity photo opportunity arranged by Franklin and Beverly spirals into chaos.

pois.title: Paparazzo - The Meltdown
pois.note: Beverly needs footage of a celebrity's public breakdown, and Franklin is sent to film it.
objectives: Stay close to Poppy throughout the chase
Snap a photo of Poppy after she's been cuffed

pois.title: Paparazzo - The Highness
pois.note: For Beverly's next job, Franklin pursues a celebrity from the air to snag exclusive photos.
objectives: Snap the princess without being detected
Snap the princess buying drugs

pois.title: Paparazzo - Reality Check
pois.note: After Franklin delivers his last round of celebrity photos, Beverly refuses to pay up and Franklin has to decide what happens to him.
objectives: Kill Beverly and his crew with a single shot

pois.title: Target Practice
pois.note: Trevor heads out hunting alongside his laid-back cousin, elderly mountain dweller Cletus Ewing.
objectives: Kill 2 coyotes with one shot
Shoot all 3 tires with at least 75% accuracy
Shoot all 3 satellite dishes without missing

pois.title: Fair Game
pois.note: Cletus takes Trevor elk hunting out in Paleto Forest, teaching him to stalk upwind and only take bucks with antlers.
objectives: Don't get detected by any elk
Kill 3 elk with a heart shot

pois.title: Risk Assessment
pois.note: After freeing thrill-seeker Dom Beasley from a tree, Franklin joins him for a parachute-and-bicycle descent down Mount Chiliad.
objectives: Free-fall for 7 seconds before opening the parachute
Get 2 seconds of air during the bicycle race
Win the bicycle race against Dom

pois.title: Liquidity Risk
pois.note: Dom invites Franklin to take part in a wingsuit BASE-jumping stunt.
objectives: Perform 8 spins on the Blazer while skydiving
Survive a water landing without opening the parachute

pois.title: Targeted Risk
pois.note: Franklin is back with Dom for another death-defying stunt challenge.
objectives: Free-fall for 8 seconds before opening the parachute
Land perfectly on the back of the truck

pois.title: Uncalculated Risk
pois.note: Dom's strand of dangerous stunts wraps up with one last extreme challenge alongside Franklin - unlocks once every Parachute Jump is done.
objectives: Jump after Dom and survive the fall

pois.title: A Starlet in Vinewood
pois.note: Reveals that washed-up actor Peter Dreyfuss murdered Leonora Johnson decades ago, and Franklin confronts him about it.
objectives: Kill Dreyfuss

pois.title: Seeking The Truth
pois.note: Michael takes the Epsilon personality test and is pulled into the cult - the first step toward "enlightenment."
objectives: Donate $500 to the Epsilon Program

pois.title: Accepting The Truth
pois.note: Michael sinks further into the Epsilon Program, handing over more of his savings to prove his devotion.
objectives: Donate $5,000 to the Epsilon Program

pois.title: Assuming the Truth
pois.note: Epsilon has Michael prove his faith by stealing five specific cars and delivering each one to the cult's Vinewood garage. Four are reliable neighborhood spawns rather than guaranteed single pickups - loop the block if one's not there yet.
objectives: Deliver a Pegassi Vacca (driveway on Wild Oats Drive, Vinewood Hills)
Deliver a Benefactor Surano (cul-de-sac on Lake Vinewood Drive, Vinewood Hills)
Deliver an Enus Super Diamond (GWC and Golfing Society parking lot, or from the "Fresh Meat" random event in Great Chaparral)
Deliver a Dinka Double-T (outside the LifeInvader offices, Rockford Hills)
Deliver a Declasse Tornado (ambient traffic - no fixed spot, starts spawning once the mission begins)

pois.title: Chasing The Truth
pois.note: Michael takes an alien-detecting gadget out into the desert to dig up a buried artifact, then hands the Program another $10,000 donation.
objectives: Find the alien artifact without using the detector

pois.title: Bearing The Truth
pois.note: Epsilon demands Michael buy their trademark blue robes and prove his commitment by living in them for over a week.
objectives: Buy the Epsilon Robes ($25,000)
Wear the Epsilon Robes for 10 cumulative in-game days

pois.title: Delivering The Truth
pois.note: Michael flies a blue Velum out to Sandy Shores to deliver it to Jimmy Boston, threading it under a bridge along the way.
objectives: Land the Velum without damaging it
Fly under a bridge along Lago Zancudo

pois.title: Exercising The Truth
pois.note: Epsilon's final test of devotion: Michael must walk five miles through the Grand Senora Desert in his robes, on foot and alone.
objectives: Walk 5 miles through the Grand Senora Desert while wearing the Epsilon Robes

pois.title: Unknowing The Truth
pois.note: The Epsilon Program storyline reaches its conclusion as Michael raids the cult's compound and decides whether to walk away with their money.
objectives: Kill all members of the Epsilon security team
Grab the Epsilon funds and escape the area

Finish the race with fewer than 5 collisions

objectives: Complete the mission without alerting the cops
Pour the gasoline perfectly in one go

pois.title: Under the Bridge 1
pois.note: Approach this bridge span at a steady speed and keep your vehicle centered under the crossing as you pass beneath it.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 2
pois.note: Line up with the gap beneath the bridge deck well in advance, then hold a straight course through the opening at a controlled pace.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 3
pois.note: Whether you take this one by boat or aircraft, the key is staying level and centered as you slip under the span.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 4
pois.note: Build enough speed on the approach to carry you cleanly under the bridge without losing control mid-pass.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 5
pois.note: Keep an eye on the pylons supporting the deck here and aim for the middle of the gap between them.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 6
pois.note: This crossing rewards a calm, steady line - ease off any sharp turns once you're lined up with the underside of the span.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 7
pois.note: A boat or jet ski threading the water beneath this bridge works just as well as an aircraft passing low through the gap.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 8
pois.note: Watch your vertical clearance closely on the way in, since the underside of the deck sits lower than it first appears.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 9
pois.note: Pick your line early and commit to it - drifting off-center under the span is the easiest way to clip a support.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 10
pois.note: This one's straightforward by boat: hold a consistent speed and pass directly beneath the roadway overhead.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 11
pois.note: If you're coming in low by plane or helicopter, level your wings or rotor well before reaching the bridge deck.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 12
pois.note: Keep the throttle steady and the nose level as you glide under this crossing's supports.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 13
pois.note: A Maverick barely clears the supports here. Line up with the opening, touch down first to shed your forward speed, then lift off again and ease through at a moderate pace, making only small corrections.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 14
pois.note: The gap under the deck here is wide enough for most boats, but aircraft need a careful, level approach.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 15
pois.note: Another tight fit that leaves little clearance - land first to cancel your momentum, then take off and cruise through at a controlled speed, adjusting only slightly as you go.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 16
pois.note: Time your pass so you're already centered under the span before you reach the shadow of the deck.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 17
pois.note: A calm approach beats a fast one here - ease into the gap rather than rushing the pass.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 18
pois.note: Whether by water or by air, keep your vehicle's course dead straight as you go under the bridge.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 19
pois.note: Watch for the support pylons rising out of the water and aim to split the distance between them.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 20
pois.note: This crossing is best taken at a moderate, controlled speed rather than flat out.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 21
pois.note: Line up well before the bridge comes into view so you're not making last-second corrections underneath it.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 22
pois.note: A boat handles this one comfortably; low-flying aircraft will need to watch their altitude closely on the approach.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 23
pois.note: Keep the vehicle level through the pass - any last-second tilt risks clipping the underside of the deck.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 24
pois.note: The water beneath this span offers plenty of room if you keep a straight, centered line.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 25
pois.note: Approach steadily and resist the urge to swerve once you're committed to the gap.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 26
pois.note: This bridge's understructure has enough clearance for most vehicles if you keep your course true.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 27
pois.note: Aim for the center of the arch beneath the roadway and hold your speed steady through the pass.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 28
pois.note: A smooth, level approach by boat or aircraft is all this crossing really asks for.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 29
pois.note: Give yourself plenty of distance to line up before reaching the bridge's shadow.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 30
pois.note: The gap here is generous, but a straight approach still makes for the cleanest pass.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 31
pois.note: Keep your vehicle's nose pointed at the middle of the span as you close the distance.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 32
pois.note: This one rewards patience - slow down slightly on the approach to keep your line true.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 33
pois.note: Almost no vertical room for a Maverick to pass without the rotor clipping the bridge or the skids touching the water - build forward speed, keep the helicopter level, and hold a steady altitude all the way through the gap.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 34
pois.note: Whether on water or in the air, hold a steady altitude or draft as you go under the deck.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 35
pois.note: Watch the pylons on either side and split the gap evenly between them.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 36
pois.note: A confident, level approach carries you cleanly under this crossing.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 37
pois.note: Keep your speed consistent through the pass rather than accelerating or braking mid-gap.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 38
pois.note: This span's underside offers a clear path if you commit early to a straight line.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 39
pois.note: Aircraft should trim for level flight before reaching the bridge; boats just need to hold their heading.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 40
pois.note: Take this one at a measured pace, correcting gently rather than sharply as you pass beneath.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 41
pois.note: Line up with the center of the gap and hold that line all the way through.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 42
pois.note: A steady hand on the controls is all that's needed to clear this crossing's underside.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 43
pois.note: This bridge sits low enough that a careful, level approach matters more than raw speed.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 44
pois.note: Keep your vehicle centered under the roadway as the shadow of the deck passes overhead.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 45
pois.note: The pass here is forgiving if you keep your course straight and your speed under control.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 46
pois.note: Approach with the bridge dead ahead and avoid drifting to either side as you go under.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 47
pois.note: Whether you're on the water or in the air, a level, unhurried pass gets you through cleanly.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 48
pois.note: Watch for the support beams on either side of the gap and aim to split the difference between them.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 49
pois.note: This crossing's understructure has room to spare for a vehicle holding a straight, steady line.

pois.title: Under the Bridge 50
pois.note: Keep your approach calm and centered, and this span's underside poses little trouble.
